source: L926 (owner 2026-11-02: a decently hard but rewarding XP system; players keep one character).
(R) The server owns the thresholds: the client only draws the rank and the percent toward the next one.

(R) total_to_20 per job: max(the job's one-time quest stars in the archived fanbyte wiki / 0.45, 7,500), so the one-time quests reach about level 14; jobs with fast repeatable quests (combat contracts at one repeat per 15 minutes) are raised so about 12 hours of repeatables plus the job's main activity finish level 20. Level n -> n+1 needs total * n^1.5 / sum(1..19 of n^1.5).

L927 (owner-approved, (R)): activity_xp is the XP one unit of the job's repeatable activity pays, so about 12 hours of the main activity after the quests reaches level 20: Card Duelist 466 per duel, Kart Driver 97 per race, Postman 93 per mail round, Chef 86 per cook, Blacksmith 77 per forge, Miner 63 per mining round, Demo Derby Driver 78 per match, Adventurer 14 per exploration coin, Warrior 2 / Wizard 6 / Brawler 4 / Medic 3 / Archer 4 / Ninja 4 per kill, Fisherman 8 per catch, Soccer Star 72 per match. Pet Trainer has none. A site uses its own constant when a job has no activity_xp. A field kill pays the active job's per-kill rate in place of its level-band XP (a row that pays none stays unpaid); a Chef harvesting win and a cook both pay the Chef rate; smelting pays no rate.
